Your database, made clearer.

Nodal Studio for Mac is $0.99 in the U.S. until Nov 11 (usually $19.99).

Explore PostgreSQL/MySQL schemas, review changes, and draft SQL with optional AI.

Buy once. No subscription. Regional prices vary.
